Commentary.Commentary: That concludes the proceedings for the third T20I. Another two games to go in the series. The venue is going to remain the same in Barbados and the fourth game will be on the 30th of January at 1.30 am IST (8 pm GMT, Previous Day). Do join us in advance for the coverage. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Kieron Pollard, the captain of West Indies, is happy with the way Rovman Powell took his chance and vindicated his selection. Adds that they batted well against the spinners in this match, something they were unable to do in the recent past. Shares that they had a chat related to this aspect of their game. On his bowling, Pollard replies that he just used the dimensions of the ground to his advantage. Admits that his bowling attack is inexperienced and the main challenge for them will be to replicate this performance.

Moeen Ali, the skipper of England, says that they were done a little bit with Eoin Morgan not playing and three debutants in the XI, but at the same time, Moeen says that the guys played very well. Admits that West Indies were better and feels that the stand between Nicholas Pooran and Rovman Powell took the game away from them. Mentions that he is proud of the boys as they were there till the end. States that Tom Banton was outstanding, and this knock will help his confidence. Concludes by saying that they have confidence in their side and they knew this would be a brilliant series.

Rovman Powell is the Player of the Match! Says that he had a chat with his skipper the previous night, and he knew he was going to play. Mentions that he can strike the ball well, but he has certain issues against wrist spinners and he has been working hard on that. Says that Adil Rashid is England's best bowler, and they tried to get fewer runs off him and attack the other bowlers. Concludes by saying he got every shot out of the middle of the bat!
Presentation time...

West Indies will be extremely happy with the way they batted and posted a gigantic total on the board. It appeared to be a tough wicket for batting but the way Rovman Powell and Nicholas Pooran batted, they made batting look very easy. The former was in incredible form and struck a valiant ton to become only the third West Indian to do so in this format. Pooran also found his lost mojo and their partnership was the prime reason for West Indies getting such a massive total. Although they defended the target, their bowling was not up to the desired level. They kept on leaking runs but the good part was that they kept on picking wickets as well. On a surface like this, perhaps that's the only way to win as stopping the flow of runs was not easy. The combined 8 overs of Kieron Pollard and Sheldon Cottrell should be credited the most here as they kept the scoring rate under check and made sure the required rate remained alarmingly high.

Chasing a mammoth target, the intention from England was very clear. They wanted to get a rollicking start and didn't care about preserving the wickets. Tom Banton led the charge with his scintillating knock but he didn't receive enough support from the top order. Losing James Vince, Moeen Ali and Liam Livingstone in quick succession didn't help their cause and once Banton got out, the writing was on the wall. However, debutant Philip Salt's assault made this chase interesting and he tried his best towards the end. In hindsight, had England concentrated on preserving the wickets a little bit, this target could have been chased. Anyway, they fought hard and despite just two healthy knocks, they managed to run West Indies close.

An outstanding victory for West Indies to again take a lead in the series! It was a high-scoring entertainer with both teams shining brightly with the bat. Things appeared to get close towards the end but eventually, West Indies had got 20 runs too many on the board. Nonetheless, England fought well.
Romario Shepherd ends with a low full toss, outside off. Reece Topley pushes it towards long off. One run is taken. That's it! West Indies win by 20 runs and they take a 2-1 lead in this series!
Another yorker, around middle. Tymal Mills gets an inside edge and the ball rolls towards square leg for a single.
Yorker-length delivery, around middle. Reece Topley pushes it towards long off. A single taken.
Reece Topley is the last batsman.

OUT! TIMBER! That should be game, set and match! A leg-stump yorker from Romario Shepherd, fast and furious, Philip Salt tries to whip it across the line but misses. The stumps behind are shattered and Shepherd gives a stare to the batsman. Great comeback, Romario Shepherd has the last laugh.
SIX! Here is another one! This is an assault! A low full toss around off, Philip Salt attacks it and smashes it all the way over mid-wicket. 24 needed off 4 balls. The momentum is with England now.
SIX! FIFTY FOR SALT ON DEBUT! Very full, outside of off. Philip Salt slaps this over the bowler's head for a biggie. He is not going down without a fight.
TWO WIDES! Short ball, around off. Tymal Mills swings his bat but misses! The batter steals a bye. 36 needed off 6 balls.
Tymal Mills walks in next.

OUT! RUN OUT! Adil Rashid has thrown his wicket here! England slip further! A short ball, outside off. Philip Salt goes for the pull but misses. Adil Rashid leaves his crease from the other end to get Philip Salt back on strike for the next over, but Philip Salt is unmoved! Shai Hope collects the ball and gives it back to the bowler, who calmly whips the bails off.
Adil Rashid is the next batsman.
Back of a length, around off. Adil Rashid dabs it to point for a single.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Here comes the Salute! Sheldon Cottrell delivers it on a length, around off and gets it to skid off the surface, George Garton tries to open up the leg-side field with his attempted heave but misses the ball completely. It goes through to hit the off stump and another one bites the dust for England.
Swing and a miss! Short ball, around off. George Garton misses his pull. Dot ball.
Fuller this time, wide of off. Philip Salt knocks it down to long off for a single.
Good-length delivery, outside off. George Garton steps down and drives it towards cover. A single taken.
Another fuller-length delivery, around middle. George Garton pushes it to long on for a single.
Fuller, around off. Philip Salt drives it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Slower ball, around middle, touch shorter. Philip Salt hangs back and slaps this towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. Back-to-back boundaries for him!
FOUR! A low full, around middle. Philip Salt heaves it towards wide of long on. Rovman Powell chases it from long on but fails to keep it out. A boundary.
Fuller, outside off. Philip Salt offers no shot.
Another debutant, George Garton, is the new batsman.

OUT! TAKEN! Jason Holder strikes this time and England lose their sixth wicket! A slower ball, wide of off, very full. Harry Brook reaches out for it and tries to go over long on. He gets the elevation, but not the distance. Rovman Powell takes an easy catch near the fence to dismiss Harry Brook.
Commentary.Howout: c Rovman Powell b Jason Holder

Commentary.Commentary: Bowling change. Jason Holder returns to operate.
SIX! PUNISHED! Overpitched delivery, around off. Philip Salt heaves this over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. Good end to the over for England!
Back of a length, around middle. Harry Brook pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Swing and a miss! On a length, around middle. Harry Brook backs away and looks to chop this, but misses.
On a length, around middle, Harry Brook shuffles across and looks to lap this over on the leg side but misses.
Touch fuller, around off. Philip Salt knocks it down to long off for a single.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Sheldon Cottrell serves a short ball, around middle. Philip Salt stays in his crease and pulls it towards deep square leg for a boundary. That nearly went all the way.
Sheldon Cottrell is back into the attack. 2-0-13-0 are his figures thus far.
Outside off, yorker. Philip Salt squeezes it out towards point for a single. 63 needed off 24 balls.
SIX! HAMMERED! Romario Shepherd once again misses his length and serves a low full toss, around off. Philip Salt gets under it, and tonks it straight down the ground for a biggie.
Very full, outside off. Harry Brook dabs it towards point. A single taken.
Much better this time! Yorker-length delivery, around middle. Philip Salt pushes it towards long on for a single.
Romario Shepherd misses his length again, another low full toss. Harry Brook knocks it towards long off for a single.
A low full toss, around middle. Philip Salt punches it over the bowler's head for a single.
Romario Shepherd (2-0-31-2) is back into the attack.
Camps back and smashes a short ball past the bowler for a run at long on. 74 needed off 30 balls.
Short on middle, pulled behind square leg for a single.
Shortish and on middle, darted in, Salt tried to heave but it took the inside edge. The ball deflected off the pads to point for a single.
SIX! Bang! Quicker and fuller, around middle and leg, Philip Salt kneels and spears his sweep shot over square leg for a flat, long hit.
On the pads, worked behind square leg for a single.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Salt steps back and drills it down the ground for a single.
Akeal Hosein (2-0-25-1) is back on!

WHAT AN ATTEMPT! Akeal Hosein almost pulled off a blinder! Very full and outside off, Salt slices it towards point where Akeal Hosein jumps to pluck it with his one hand but as he lands, the ball pops out. The batters cross. A great attempt nonetheless.
Slight halt in play. Jason Holder seems to have hurt his hand in an attempt to catch the ball. The physio is out there to check on him. He seems good to go!

Put down but that was a very tough chance! Full toss wide outside off, Salt clubs it back towards the bowler. It's aerial, Holder reacts to his left but fails to grab it. The ball bursts through and goes towards wide mid off and they take a couple of runs.
Fullish again, outside off, it's caressed down to long off for one.
Too full and around off, Salt forces it down to long on for a single.
Well stopped, Fabian Allen! Short and around off, Salt pulls it powerfully to the left of the deep mid-wicket fielder. Fabian Allen dives to stop the racing ball and prevents two runs.
Too full and around middle, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Jason Holder (2-0-23-0) is brought back into the attack.
A cutter outside off, eased to covers for a single. 4-0-31-2, Pollard has done his job.
Width there outside off, Brook runs it down to third man for a couple.
Back of a length, around off, defended back.
Debutant Harry Brook comes out to bat now.

OUT! Banton holes out and this is a massive blow to England. Kieron Pollard's slower ones are doing the trick. It's full and around off, Tom Banton walks down the track and once again aims to clear long on. This time though there is neither height nor elevation. A simple catch for Jason Holder in the deep. A good effort from Tom but we are afraid to say, that won't be enough. 96 needed off 45 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Holder b Kieron Pollard

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! This is now Banton's highest individual score in T20Is. Fuller and around leg, Banton picks it off his pads and drop kicks it over wide long on for a biggie.
Play and a miss! Slower one, full and wide outside off, Banton tries to play the reverse sweep but misses.
Shepherd runs in from 'round the wicket and bowls it full and wide outside off, Tom drags it down to long on. 17 runs but a big wicket of Liam Livingstone off the over.
SIX! Hard and heavy! Romario Shepherd delivers it in the slot, Tom Banton goes down on one knee and smokes it over deep mid-wicket. Banton continues to fight for England.
SIX! Boom! A low full toss around off, Tom Banton gives it the full whack of his bat and muscles it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Wide! This one is too wide outside off, and left alone by Banton.
Uppish but safe. Fullish and wide outside off, again off pace and deceiving the batter, Banton chips it over point and it falls safely. They take two.
Too full in length and wide outside off, Banton chases but misses. There is some noise, but it's of the bat hitting the deck.

OUT! That's a fantastic catch to dismiss Liam Livingstone. Full in length and wide outside off, making the batter reach out for it. Livingstone falls into the trap as he chases and gets it away from the toe end of his bat. The ball flies towards extra cover where Akeal Hosein backtracks and takes a wonderful catch over his head. England continue to lose wickets.
Commentary.Howout: c Akeal Hosein b Romario Shepherd

Commentary.Commentary: Philip Salt comes to the crease now.
Wide! False start. Bowls it on a length but way wide outside off.
Romario Shepherd (1-0-14-1) is back into the attack.
Short and on off, pulled down to long on for one. 119 needed off 54 balls.
Wide! Pollard tries to stay away from the hitting zone of Liam but in that process, he ends up spraying it way wide outside off. Liam leaves.

Miscued! Short in length around off, slower in pace but it has some extra bounce, Liam Livingstone top-edges his attempted pull shot. The ball falls in no man's land at deep mid-wicket and they take two.
Fuller and outside off, Liam Livingstone drives but finds the extra cover fielder inside the ring. Dot.
Short and outside off, slapped through extra cover for a single.
Angling in from middle, Liam eases it down to wide long on for a single.
Short in length, outside off and off pace, Banton shuffles across and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run. 100 up for England.

SIX! BOOM! Touch fuller, around middle. Liam Livingstone steps down the pitch and heaves this over deep mid-wicket for a biggie! England are 99 for 3 at the halfway mark. They need 126 more off 60 balls.
Touch fuller, around middle. Tom Banton knocks it down to long on for a single. FIFTY for Tom Banton! An excellent inning! But he knows his job is only half done here!
Back of a length, around off. Liam Livingstone shuffles across and works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another shorter ball, outside off. Liam Livingstone shows the full face of the bat and blocks it out.
Back of a length, around off. Liam Livingstone walks down and tries to flick it on the leg side, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards the off side.

Liam Livingstone is in some discomfort and calls the physio. The umpires take the opportunity to call for the Drinks break. This match is firmly in favour of West Indies at the moment. They have leaked runs but at the same time, they have managed to pick wickets. Tom Banton has stuck around for some time but he will need support from the other end. There is depth in this English batting line-up but the asking rate is already alarming. Can they press the accelerator?
Full and on middle, knocked down to long on for a run.
Rovman Powell has the ball in his hands.
Short, wide of off. Tom Banton pushes it toward covers for a single. He retains the strike. End of a successful over by Kieron Pollard!
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Tom Banton flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for two runs.
Liam Livingstone walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Change of pace does the trick for Kieron Pollard! Moeen Ali departs early in the innings. Fuller ball, outside off, and slower one this time. Moeen Ali looks to go over the off side but he is early into the shot and miscues it towards point. Rovman Powell pouches it comfortably to dismiss Moeen Ali. England in trouble.
Commentary.Howout: c Rovman Powell b Kieron Pollard

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Kieron Pollard drops it short this time, outside off. Moeen Ali just watches it sail through to the keeper. Wide called for height here.
Back of a length, on middle. Tom Banton pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Cut away! Touch shorter, width on offer. Tom Banton stays in his crease and chops this towards deep point for a cracking boundary.
Low full toss ball, on the pads. Tom Banton flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Very full, around middle. Moeen Ali clips it to mid-wicket and it nearly carries to Pollard stationed there. End of an expensive, but a successful over!
Moeen Ali arrives. 146 needed off 73 balls.

OUT! TAKEN! Akeal Hosein strikes and gets the second wicket! Good comeback by him! Another shorter ball, outside off. James Vince backs away again, slashes this but fails to get any elevation. The ball flies and goes to Kieron Pollard at extra cover who takes a simple catch. James Vince walks back to the hut.
Commentary.Howout: c Kieron Pollard b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Another six in the over, this time it's James Vince! A shorter ball, width on offer. James Vince makes room and slaps this over long off for a maximum.
Quicker, around leg. Tom Banton works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! DISPATCHED! Much shorter this time, around middle. Tom Banton stays in his crease and pulls it high over deep mid-wicket for a 96-metre six!
Outside off, touch shorter. James Vince taps it towards point for a single.
On a length, outside off. Tom Banton looks to reverse-scoop this but misses. Good start by the skipper!
Back of a length, around middle. James Vince pulls it towards mid-wicket. A single taken.
Fraction shorter, outside of off again. Tom Banton carves it towards point again for another single.
Another length ball, wide of off. James Vince cuts it towards point and rotates the strike.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Tom Banton drives it towards cover for a single.
Very full, around off. Tom Banton pushes it towards mid off. No run there.
Bowling change. Kieron Pollard brings himself into the attack.
Flatter, around off. Tom Banton knocks it down towards mid off for a single. England are 61/1 at the end of the Powerplay!
Swing and a miss! Touch fuller, outside off. Tom Banton looks to heave this over on the leg side but misses as the ball turns away from him.
Touch shorter again, around off. Tom Banton plays it to the fielder at mid off.
Shorter ball, spinning away from outside off. Tom Banton, on the back foot, pushes it towards cover.
We've lost the ball. The umpires have called for the replacement. Kieron Pollard takes this opportunity to have a conflab with his players.
SIX! Up, up and away! This one is right in the slot, on middle. Tom Banton gets low and sweeps this over deep mid-wicket for a huge six!
FOUR! Welcome to the attack, Akeal Hosein! A flatter ball, on middle. Tom Banton steps down the pitch and punches it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Akeal Hosein comes into the attack.
Short and slow around off, Vince guides his pull straight to short fine leg.
Too full and on middle, it's kept out towards mid-wicket for a run.
Short and on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Easy pickings. Another full toss, around leg, Banton picks it off his pads and smashes it to deep backward square leg for a boundary.
Full toss around leg, whipped to deep mid-wicket. Hayden Walsh (sub) misfielded and allowed the second run.
On a length and outside off, Banton stays back and eases it to backward point.
Jason Holder comes back into the attack. Switch of ends for him!
Aerial but safe! James Vince tries to glance a length ball across the line but closes the face of his bat early. It flies off the top edge and clears short third man. Two taken.
Pushes a full ball in the gap at covers for a run.
Short again, outside off, forced to deep cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Short in length and outside off to greet the new batsman, Vince shows his class there as he steers it through point for a boundary.
James Vince comes to bat at number 3.

OUT! Roy holes out! 'Oh, no!' That's the reaction from Jason Roy as soon as the ball left his bat. Romario Shepherd pitches it just ahead of a length, around middle, Jason Roy tries to power it again down the ground but it takes the bottom part of his bat. It flies straight down Jason Holder's throat and he makes no mistake at long on.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Holder b Romario Shepherd

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Lovely swing of the bat and this has been dispatched. Back of a length, around off, Roy reached out and hoists it over long on.
Romario Shepherd comes into the attack.
Outthinks the batsman. Sheldon Cottrell dishes out the slower one, on a length and outside off, Tom Banton tries to be cheeky with his shot but fails to connect.
Around leg, eased through square leg for a single.
A touch short and close to leg, not offering any width, Roy is cramped for room and fails to play it out.
Stifled appeal for an lbw! Good change of pace, full and around off, angling away, Roy tries to flick but misses. He is pinged on the pads but outside the line of the stumps.
Wide! A pacy delivery, short but down the leg side at 139 kph, Roy tries to glance but misses.
Slower one, on a length and around off, Roy pushes it with an angled bat to point.
SIX! High and handsome! Now, Roy goes big. A touch short and on off, Jason hangs on the back foot, uses his long reach and powers it over long on.
SIX! First of the chase! Full and wide outside off, in the zone for the batter, Banton flexes his arms and dispatches it behind the bowler's head for a maximum.
Too full and on middle, at 127 kph, Roy digs it out off the inner half to square leg for a run.
Another slower one and again Roy is beaten. Full and outside off, cutting away, Jason Roy goes for an ugly swipe across the line and misses.
What a delivery! A genuine leg cutter at 105 kph, around off and gripping a lot, Roy tries to work but is completely beaten.
Full and on middle, Tom eases it in front of square leg for a run.
On the pads, it's tickled behind square leg for a single.
FIVE WIDES! Wrong start from Holder. Sprays it way down the leg side, quite wide of the batter and keeper, and it races away to the fine leg fence.
Jason Holder will bowl from the other end.
Short and on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single.

Around middle, on a length and shaping in, Roy defends it off the inner half. It drops near his feet on the leg side and Jason wants a run. He is sent back and Sheldon Cottrell attacks the ball and tries to kick it onto the stumps at the striker's end.

CATCH IT IS THE SHOUT! Just short of Rovman Powell. Short in length and around off, Roy pulls it from the toe end of his bat to deep mid-wicket. Rovman Powell rushes forward, dives but it lands just in front of him. They collect a couple.
That's ugly from Roy. Too full and around off, nipping in, Roy steps back and tries to squeeze it through the line but misses.
Swing again, a touch short and around off, Banton has his bat down in time as he works it through mid-wicket. Opens his account with a single.
A little bit of inswing, from a length around middle, Roy tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single. England are away!
